request: Build a small Jac web app for bookmarks. Users save bookmarks with tags, each either private or shared. A shared view lists everyone's shared bookmarks; a user's own view shows all of their bookmarks. Both views take a tag query where every listed tag must match and '!tag' excludes a tag. Only the owner can edit a bookmark.
acceptance: User B's shared view never includes user A's private bookmarks; A's own view does.
The query 'dev !old' returns bookmarks tagged dev and not tagged old; tag matching ignores case.
User B cannot edit A's shared bookmark even though B can see it.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
